name: smarttravel-monorepo
description: SmartTravel - Full-Stack Real-Time Bus Booking, Tracking & Destination Alarm Platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.render:build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
